discovery_path.what_happened: At the author's request ('A run on another machine, then building the snapshot'), the would-be snapshot tree baddd874 (from c5a60df) was run in release mode on CSC Roihu, twice (Slurm jobs 2922240 and 2922316). finding.size: Each of the 14 values differs in its last digit, a relative difference of at most 2.2e-16 (one unit in the last place), for example 0.004011279957868068 against 0.004011279957868069. Both Roihu runs gave the same values. No count, estimate, interval, call, adjusted_p or rounded value changed.
finding.origin: A platform difference between the Roihu run and the Windows machine. Which floating-point operation differs was not established.

The gate itself passes only when result_registry.tsv is byte-identical to one approved by a signed record; git diff of result_registry.tsv shows what moved.

decision.registered_values: Unchanged. The registry keeps the approved values, and no approval record is added for the Linux registry.

decision.readme: The registry-gate note tells the reader to compare result_registry.tsv with the tracked copy (git diff), keeps the advice to restore and rerun for meta-consensus variation, and says that on Linux the 14 last-digit sensitivity_adjusted_p rows and the two secondary_method_results.tsv hashes differ on every run.
